 For Petitioner : Mr.K.M.Aasim Shehzad  for M/s.BFS Legal  For Respondents : Mr.Ramaswamy Meyyappan  Government Advocate (Pondicher  ORDER This Writ Petition is filed seeking a writ of Certiorarified Mandamus to call for the records of the 1st respondent culminated in G.O.Ms.No.36, Department of Revenue and Disaster Management dated 05.10.2010 in the Gazette of Puducherry and the consequent G.O.Ms.No.62, Department of Revenue and Disaster Management dated 02.03.2011 in the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Gazette of Puducherry, in so far as the schedule mentioned property and quash the entire acquisition proceedings.

2. The main contention of the petitioner is that the acquisition notification was issued on 02.03.2011 and within two years from the date of publication of acquisition proceedings, the Award ought to have been passed, but in this case, the Award was passed after lapse of two years on 25.09.2013 and therefore, the notification in G.O.Ms.No.36, Department of Revenue and Disaster Management dated 05.10.2010 in the Gazette of Puducherry and the consequent G.O.Ms.No.62, Department of Revenue and Disaster Management dated 02.03.2011 in the Gazette of Puducherry, have to be quashed.

He also placed reliance on the decision of this Court in W.P.No.33245 of 2013 (Mohamed Sultan Maraicar Vs. The Special Secretary, Government of Puducherry, Department of Revenue and Disaster Management and Ors.), dated 19.07.2016.

entities.text: Mohamed Sultan Maraicar Vs. The Special Secretary, Government of Puducherry, Department of Revenue and Disaster Management and Ors.

sentences.text: However, in that case, no notice was issued to the land owner and no opportunity of personal hearing was given and on that ground, the Court quashed the acquisition proceedings, whereas in this case, notice was issued to the petitioner and the petitioner has also participated.
The only grievance of the petitioner is that the award was not passed within two years from the date of notification. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

Mr.Ramaswamy Meyyappan, learned Government Advocate (Pondicherry), appearing for the respondents submitted that even during pendency of the writ petition, the petitioner accepted to receive money and by letter dated 25.11.2023, they have expressed their internal dispute between the petitioner/Society and the Waqf Board and based on the said letter, the authorities calculated compensation under the New Act and also deposited the compensation amount and the copy of the challan is also annexed.
4. Once the petitioner accepted to receive the compensation and based on which, the authorities have also deposited the amount, the relief sought for in the writ petition became infructuous.
5. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.

Consequently,
connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
